# Language Version

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LanguageVersion`](gmeow-LanguageVersion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LanguageVersion>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

A concrete, dated revision of a language that is itself a fully usable language (Ithkuil 1993 / 2011 / New Ithkuil; an AI language v1 / v2). Subclass of [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md) so a version bears its own scripts, names and status; [`gmeow:versionOf`](../properties/gmeow-versionOf.md) links it to the lineage language, [`gmeow:supersedes`](../properties/gmeow-supersedes.md) orders versions, and [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md) records derivation. Forward-looking for rapidly-versioned AI languages.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LanguageVersion`](gmeow-LanguageVersion.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
